items.source: Add JSON based on further JsonWriter.Members configuration.
items.translation: 添加基于进一步的JsonWriter.Members配置的 JSON。

items.source: Add a new member with access to the instance being written.
items.translation: 添加一个新成员，使其能够访问正在写入的实例。

items.source: Add JSON name/value pairs by extracting values from a series of elements.
items.translation: 通过从一系列元素中提取值来添加 JSON 名称/值对。

items.source: Uses of JsonWriter.Member in org.springframework.boot.json
items.translation: `JsonWriter.Member` 在 `org.springframework.boot.json` 中的用法

items.source: Only include this member when it is not null and has a toString() that is not zero length.
items.translation: 仅在成员不为 null 且其 toString() 不为空长度时包含该成员。

items.source: Add all entries from the given Map to the JSON.
items.translation: 将给定Map中的所有条目添加到 JSON 中。

items.source: Adapt the value by applying the given Function.
items.translation: 通过应用给定的Function来调整该值。

items.source: Only include this member when it is not empty (See ObjectUtils.isEmpty(Object) for details).
items.translation: 仅在非空时包含此成员（有关详细信息，请参阅 ObjectUtils.isEmpty(Object)）。

items.source: Only include this member when its value is not null.
items.translation: 仅当其值不为null时才包含此成员。

items.source: Only include this member when an extracted value is not null.
items.translation: 仅在提取的值不为null时包含此成员。

items.source: Support for parsing JSON.
items.translation: 支持解析 JSON。

items.source: Add a new member with a static value.
items.translation: 添加一个具有静态值的新成员。

items.source: Add a new member with a supplied value.
items.translation: 添加一个具有指定值的新成员。

items.source: Add a new member with an extracted value.
items.translation: 添加一个具有提取值的新成员。

items.source: Add members from a static value.
items.translation: 从静态值添加成员。

items.source: Add members from a supplied value.
items.translation: 从提供的值添加成员。

items.source: Add members from an extracted value.
items.translation: 从提取的值中添加成员。

items.source: Add JSON name/value pairs.
items.translation: 添加 JSON 名称/值对。

items.source: Only include this member when the given predicate matches.
items.translation: 仅当给定谓词匹配时包含此成员。

items.source: Only include this member when the given predicate does not match.
items.translation: 仅在给定谓词不匹配时包含此成员。
